summary: East kerb backing onto a park, with cars parked along it.

drivers.seclusion: Park and tree screen on the section's side; nearest homes 22-24 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane where cars are parked in QLD and Esri; room for a van beside the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street just off a junction; some passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Parked cars along both kerbs, so a van will not stand out.

sun_shade: Trees along the kerb shade it mostly from the east; open park beyond.

best_section.where: Moorak Street east kerb, beside the park near the corner
